data.sources_note: 來源與日期逐篇列明。公司公告按原文歸因，開放範圍以可核對的資料為準。
data.sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
data.thesis: AI連接受眾、創意與交易資料，推出範圍及批准責任須分清
data.thesis_en: AI connects audiences, creative and commerce while rollout scope and approvals remain explicit
data.thesis_note: Koa受眾、Pinterest計劃及旅遊創意委託帶來新流程；香港衡量導入及電商工具保留原公告日期，不把機制當成效。
data.thesis_note_en: Koa audiences, Pinterest's planned inventory and a travel creative remit meet regional measurement and commerce tools, retaining original dates and separating mechanisms from outcomes.

items.title: The Trade Desk接入OnAudience，Koa可按簡報建立及啟用受眾
items.title_en: The Trade Desk connects OnAudience audience building and activation to Koa
items.summary: The Trade Desk宣布把OnAudience接入Koa，讓廣告團隊以自然語言尋找及建立受眾。
items.summary_en: The Trade Desk announced an OnAudience integration for finding and building audiences through natural-language requests in Koa.
highlights: 第三方受眾分組可配對活動簡報，並支援直接啟用。
公司表示已在全球提供；速度與準確度未經本刊實測。
highlights_en: Third-party segments can be matched to campaign briefs and activated.
The company says it is globally available; speed and accuracy were not independently tested.
items.why: 簡報與受眾操作接在一起，媒體策劃可先審查系統選了哪些分組，再決定把哪一組帶進投放。
items.why_en: Connected briefing and audience operations let planners inspect selected segments before choosing which to activate.
items.next_step: 用一份現有活動簡報要求Koa提出受眾分組，逐項核對分組定義與目標客群，再批准啟用名單。
items.next_step_en: Ask Koa for segments against an existing brief, compare definitions with the intended audience and approve the activation list.
items.detail: 這次新增的是OnAudience與Koa的連接，不能把原有MCP服務本身當成全新推出。MCP是讓AI工具連接外部資料及功能的協定。對策劃人員而言，重點是把簡報要求逐項對回受眾定義，並保留選擇分組的理由。公告所述操作機制不等於已證明更高轉換率，仍應用實際活動結果評估分組是否合適。
items.detail_en: The new event is the Koa connection, not the creation of OnAudience MCP. MCP links AI tools to external data and functions. Planners should document how segment definitions meet the brief. The workflow does not establish better conversion; evaluate suitability against campaign results.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Pinterest宣布接入Microsoft Advertising，首階段涵蓋北美及澳紐
items.title_en: Pinterest announces Microsoft Advertising integration for North America, Australia and New Zealand
items.summary: Pinterest計劃讓合資格Microsoft Advertising活動延伸至平台的視覺探索版位，首批地區為北美及澳紐。
items.summary_en: Pinterest plans to extend eligible Microsoft Advertising campaigns into visual discovery inventory, initially in North America, Australia and New Zealand.
highlights: 涵蓋首頁、搜尋及相關Pin，透過公開競價投放。
使用Pinterest Intelligence視覺及行為訊號；推出日期與資格細則未列明。
highlights_en: Planned open-auction placements include the home feed, search and related Pins.
Pinterest Intelligence supplies visual and behavioral signals; timing and eligibility details remain unspecified.
items.why: 搜尋活動將可進入視覺探索場景，買手需分開評估搜尋意圖與圖片瀏覽環境，決定哪些現有活動值得延伸。
items.why_en: Search campaigns could enter visual discovery contexts, requiring buyers to choose which existing campaigns fit that browsing environment.
items.next_step: 先列出北美及澳紐的Microsoft活動，按圖片素材與產品探索意圖篩選試點，待平台確認資格及日期才安排支出。
items.next_step_en: Shortlist North American and Australasian campaigns by visual assets and discovery intent, then confirm eligibility and dates before allocating spend.
items.detail: 公告描述沿用既有購買與衡量工具，並非要求廣告主另建一套操作介面。團隊可先標記哪些搜尋活動已有足夠圖片素材，以及哪些產品需要比較和探索，作為接入準備。視覺訊號的加入並不能直接證明新增轉換；推出後仍要分版位檢查流量與成效，不能把尚未公布的資格、格式或時間表補寫成定案。
items.detail_en: The announcement describes familiar buying and measurement tools. Teams can prepare by identifying search campaigns with suitable imagery and products that benefit from exploration. Visual signals do not establish incremental conversion. Review placement-level results after access is confirmed and keep unspecified formats, eligibility and timing open.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: loveholidays委託Nest製作AI社交廣告，以投放表現回饋下一批創意
items.title_en: loveholidays appoints Nest for AI creative with performance feeding the next ad batch
items.summary: loveholidays委託Nest Commerce提供創意策略及AI廣告製作，計劃每月產出200則付費社交素材。
items.summary_en: loveholidays appointed Nest Commerce for creative strategy and AI production, with a remit for 200 paid-social ads a month.
highlights: 製作範圍涵蓋英國、愛爾蘭及德國，並非已交付200則的成效報告。
已投放廣告的表現用於下一批製作，專家逐則做品牌審核。
highlights_en: The remit covers the UK, Ireland and Germany; it is not a report of 200 completed ads.
Live-ad performance informs subsequent production, with expert brand review of each ad.
items.why: 旅遊素材製作加入投放回饋後，團隊可把預訂動機拆成可比較的版本，決定下一批應保留哪種訴求。
items.why_en: Performance feedback lets travel teams compare booking motivations and decide which appeals to retain in the next batch.
items.next_step: 以同一行程分別測試選擇、方便、支援及期待四種預訂動機，固定主要投放條件，再把結果轉成下一批創意簡報。
items.next_step_en: Test choice, ease, support and anticipation for one trip under comparable delivery conditions, then use results in the next brief.
items.detail: 消息來自Nest Commerce公告轉載。簡報圍繞選擇、方便、支援及期待等旅遊動機，提供的是素材生成與回饋機制，未公布此委託的轉換或收入結果。編輯建議把每個版本對應的預訂理由寫入素材清單，讓下一輪修訂可以追溯至具體觀察；AI產量與人手品牌審核都不能代替對銷售成效的獨立判斷。
items.detail_en: This is a reproduced Nest Commerce announcement. The brief uses choice, ease, support and anticipation as travel motivations; it reports no conversion or revenue results for the remit. Tag each variant by booking reason so revisions can be traced to observations. Production volume and brand review do not establish sales effectiveness.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: WPP Media聯手Viewerslogic，把LLM活動納入購物旅程觀察
items.title_en: WPP Media partners with Viewerslogic to observe LLM activity in purchase journeys
items.summary: The Media Leader報道，WPP Media與Viewerslogic合作，把大型語言模型（LLM）活動連同媒體接觸及購物行為納入旅程觀察。
items.summary_en: The Media Leader reports that WPP Media and Viewerslogic will examine large language model (LLM) activity alongside media exposure and shopping behavior.
highlights: 方法使用一萬名自願加入的英國用戶面板。
觀察電視、手機瀏覽、購物及LLM活動，並非對香港消費者的推算。
highlights_en: The described method uses an opt-in panel of 10,000 UK users.
It observes TV, mobile browsing, shopping and LLM activity; it is not a Hong Kong population estimate.
items.why: AI發現加入跨接點旅程後，品牌可把「被AI提及」與「之後有否到站購物」分開追問，決定衡量計劃需要哪些行為連接。
items.why_en: Connected journey observation lets brands distinguish AI mentions from subsequent site visits and purchases when specifying measurement.
items.next_step: 為一個英國活動列出曝光、LLM使用、到站及購物四個接點，向供應商確認可觀察範圍、樣本適配及缺失資料，再決定研究設計。
items.next_step_en: Map exposure, LLM use, site visits and shopping for one UK campaign, then confirm sample fit and observable gaps before designing the study.
items.detail: 這是活動現場的直接報道，方法與功能仍按供應商描述歸因，並無本刊獨立測試。把不同接點放在同一條旅程，可提出更具體的研究問題，例如品牌接觸與AI搜尋的先後次序。觀察到先後或關聯不能單獨證明廣告造成購買；報道亦不提供把英國面板外推至香港的依據，因此本篇不採用未覆核方法的效果百分比。
items.detail_en: This is direct event reporting of a supplier-described method, not our product test. Connected observations can support questions about the sequence of brand exposure and AI discovery. Sequence alone does not establish that advertising caused purchases. We omit effectiveness percentages whose methodology was not examined and make no Hong Kong extrapolation.

items.title: WebMD Ignite推出ChatGPT廣告服務，醫療機構仍須通過平台審核
items.title_en: WebMD Ignite introduces ChatGPT ads service subject to platform eligibility and review
items.summary: WebMD Ignite宣布向合資格醫療機構提供ChatGPT廣告策劃、創意、啟動及衡量服務。
items.summary_en: WebMD Ignite announced ChatGPT advertising strategy, creative, activation and measurement services for eligible health systems.
highlights: WebMD Ignite負責策略及執行，OpenAI決定資格、素材批准及投放。
公司提及初期心臟科活動，未披露機構名稱或成效數據。
highlights_en: WebMD Ignite handles strategy and execution; OpenAI controls eligibility, creative approval and delivery.
An initial cardiology campaign is mentioned without naming the institution or reporting outcomes.
items.why: 醫療廣告多了一個服務渠道，團隊須先把服務線目標對應平台資格與審核要求，才決定是否分配測試預算。
items.why_en: A new service channel requires health marketers to match service-line objectives with platform eligibility and review before budgeting a test.
items.next_step: 選一條服務線，先取得廣告主與素材資格要求，列清WebMD Ignite及平台各自負責的批准環節，再制定衡量方案。
items.next_step_en: Select one service line, obtain advertiser and creative requirements, map provider and platform approvals, then specify measurement.
items.detail: 消息來自WebMD Ignite公司新聞稿。初期案例描述素材變體、對話情境及地域相關性的測試安排，沒有可核對的銷售或病人增長結果。編輯建議把准入條件、素材版本及評估指標分別記錄，避免把代辦服務視為保證投放成功。這次公告不能據此推定所有醫療機構均可使用，也不構成對廣告合規或私隱安排的獨立認證。
items.detail_en: The issuer release describes creative variations, conversational contexts and geographic relevance in an initial effort, with no verified growth results. Record access conditions, creative versions and assessment metrics separately. A managed service does not guarantee delivery, universal health-system access, legal compliance or independently certified privacy protections.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Sellforte與Exact AI合作，為香港零售團隊導入AI衡量流程
items.title_en: Sellforte and Exact AI bring AI-enabled measurement onboarding to Hong Kong
items.summary: Sellforte在11月18日公布Exact AI亞太合作，客戶導入範圍包括香港、澳洲及新加坡。
items.summary_en: Sellforte's November 18 APAC partnership with Exact AI covers customer onboarding in Hong Kong, Australia and Singapore.
highlights: 平台結合營銷組合建模、增量測試、歸因與預算優化。
Sellforte AI及MCP可把結果帶入AI助理；夥伴協助日常決策與季度檢討。
highlights_en: The platform combines marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, attribution and budget optimization.
AI and MCP connections bring results into assistants, with partner support for decisions and quarterly reviews.
items.why: 香港零售團隊新增本地區導入途徑，可先確認促銷、門店與網上銷售如何進入同一模型，再決定是否用於預算檢討。
items.why_en: Hong Kong retailers gain a regional onboarding route and can assess how promotions, store sales and ecommerce feed budget reviews.
items.next_step: 選一個同時有門店及網店的品牌，列清價格、促銷與銷售資料，要求夥伴示範模型假設如何連到季度預算建議。
items.next_step_en: For one omnichannel brand, list price, promotion and sales inputs and ask how model assumptions connect to quarterly budget recommendations.
items.detail: 這是11月18日的合作公告，本篇保留原日期，沒有把後續新聞稿重發當成新推出。營銷組合建模以整體資料估算渠道貢獻，結果需要結合資料覆蓋與假設解讀。編輯建議在選型時要求展示促銷及價格變化的處理方式，避免把模型估計直接當成已實測的增量回報；公告沒有提供香港客戶的獨立成效證據。
items.detail_en: This is the November 18 partnership announcement, not a later release date recast as a launch. Marketing mix models estimate contributions from aggregate data and depend on coverage and assumptions. Ask how price and promotion effects are handled. Model estimates are not independently measured incremental returns; no verified Hong Kong customer results are supplied.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Constructor推出Commerce AEO，把AI引流追蹤接到商品內容修訂
items.title_en: Constructor's Commerce AEO connects AI referral tracking to product-content changes
items.summary: Constructor在11月19日公布Commerce AEO，將AI引流的購物路徑與產品內容建議接在一起。
items.summary_en: Constructor announced Commerce AEO on November 19, connecting AI-referred shopping journeys with product-content recommendations.
highlights: 可按AI來源、商品及類別追蹤點擊、加購與購買。
根據商品資料缺漏與購物行為，建議描述、FAQ及購買指南內容。
highlights_en: The company describes tracking clicks, add-to-carts and purchases by AI source, product and category.
Product-data gaps and shopping behavior inform descriptions, FAQs and buyer guides.
items.why: AI曝光檢查加入交易訊號後，電商團隊可決定先補哪些商品資料，避免只按被提及次數分配內容製作資源。
items.why_en: Transaction signals can help ecommerce teams prioritize product-data repairs rather than allocating content work by mention counts alone.
items.next_step: 選一個有AI引流的商品類別，比較到站、加購與購買的缺口，再把缺失屬性轉成一輪FAQ及描述修訂。
items.next_step_en: Choose a category receiving AI referrals, compare visit-to-cart and purchase gaps, then turn missing attributes into a focused content revision.
items.detail: 答案引擎優化是改善產品在AI答案中的可理解性及出現機會。這次屬公司功能公告，沒有本刊驗證的增量收入結果。編輯建議先把來源辨識與交易記錄核對，確保同一類商品可以比較，再測試補全資料後的變化。即使觀察到AI來源有購買，也不能單憑路徑追蹤認定新增銷售由內容修訂造成。
items.detail_en: Answer engine optimization aims to make products understandable and discoverable in AI answers. This issuer announcement provides no independently verified incremental revenue. Reconcile referral identification with transaction records before comparing categories or testing content changes. Observed AI-referred purchases do not by themselves establish that a revision caused additional sales.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Syndigo擴展Copilot商品操作，AI修改資料須經人批准才保存
items.title_en: Syndigo expands Copilot product operations with human approval before saving changes
items.summary: Syndigo在11月18日擴展MCP功能，讓Copilot等AI助理從讀取商品資料進一步建立及修改記錄。
items.summary_en: Syndigo's November 18 MCP expansion lets Copilot and other assistants create and update product records beyond read-only access.
highlights: 可補全屬性、行銷文案及檢查零售商要求，修改前後值並排顯示。
人手批准後才保存；功能沿用客戶登入者的既有權限。
highlights_en: Assistants can enrich attributes and copy and check retailer requirements, showing proposed and current values side by side.
Changes save only after human approval and use the signed-in customer's existing permissions.
items.why: 商品準備流程增加可批准的AI寫入後，電商營運可決定哪些欄位適合批次補全，哪些文案仍須逐項審核。
items.why_en: Approval-based AI writes let commerce operations distinguish fields suitable for batch enrichment from copy requiring individual review.
items.next_step: 選一組待上架商品，指定可補全欄位及批准人，核對建議值、現值與零售商缺漏，再逐項批准保存。
items.next_step_en: Select products awaiting listing, define editable fields and approvers, then compare proposed values, existing data and retailer gaps before saving.
items.detail: MCP是連接AI助理與外部系統的協定；PIM及MDM分別管理商品資訊及主資料。公告把功能限定於Syndigo相關客戶及既有權限，並非任何Copilot用戶都能直接修改商品。編輯建議保留每次批准的欄位清單與理由，特別檢查尺寸、規格及描述是否一致；供應商聲稱的流程效率沒有在本篇被寫成已證明的銷售或速度提升。
items.detail_en: MCP connects assistants to external systems; PIM and MDM manage product information and master data. Access is for relevant Syndigo customers within existing permissions, not every Copilot user. Retain approved-field lists and inspect specifications and descriptions for consistency. The workflow is not independent proof of faster launches or increased sales.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Fast Simon推出MCP，把店面SDK與搜尋分析接入AI編碼工具
items.title_en: Fast Simon brings storefront SDK knowledge and search analytics into AI coding tools
items.summary: Fast Simon在11月19日公布MCP服務，支援Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf及Cline等編碼工具。
items.summary_en: Fast Simon announced an MCP server on November 19 supporting Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and Cline.
highlights: 開發團隊可在編碼流程內取得店面SDK實作知識。
透過商戶API金鑰，可問熱門搜尋、商品集及元件分析。
highlights_en: Developers can access storefront SDK implementation knowledge inside coding workflows.
Merchant API keys enable questions about top searches, collections and widget analytics.
items.why: 店面實作與搜尋分析接在一起後，代理商可把商品發現需求交給開發團隊時附上實際查詢依據，決定先做哪些元件。
items.why_en: Connected implementation and search analytics let agencies attach observed discovery needs to development briefs and prioritize storefront components.
items.next_step: 先從熱門搜尋選一項店面需求，讓開發團隊用SDK做測試元件，再比對分析回覆與原報表，才排入正式改版。
items.next_step_en: Choose a storefront need from top searches, build a test SDK component and reconcile analytic answers with source reports before scheduling production work.
items.detail: SDK是供開發者建立功能的軟件工具包；MCP讓AI工具連接相關知識及資料。無頭架構把店面介面與後端分開，通常需要自行整合。這次消息屬公司功能公告，本篇沒有採用「數小時取代數星期」作工期保證。編輯建議把搜尋需求、元件規格與驗收條件放在同一份簡報，避免由自然語言演示推定正式店面已可交付。
items.detail_en: An SDK supplies development tools; MCP connects AI tools to relevant knowledge and data. Headless storefronts separate the interface from backend systems and require integration. This issuer announcement does not establish a delivery-time guarantee. Keep search needs, component specifications and acceptance criteria in one brief rather than treating a demo as production readiness.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Perform.AI免費檢查網店UCP及ACP準備度，評分採固定規則
items.title_en: Perform.AI offers fixed-rule UCP and ACP readiness checks for online stores
items.summary: Perform.AI在11月18日推出免費網店檢查器，排查AI購物代理發現產品、結帳及售後介面的缺漏。
items.summary_en: Perform.AI launched a free checker on November 18 for gaps in AI shopping discovery, checkout and post-purchase interfaces.
highlights: 147項檢查按網店使用的協定評分，涵蓋發現、購買、售後及系統連接。
評分採固定規則，沒有使用LLM或AI代理；完整報告需工作資料。
highlights_en: 147 checks score the store's protocol across discovery, buying, post-purchase and connections.
Scoring uses fixed rules without an LLM or AI agent; full reports require work details.
items.why: 代理商務準備工作可拆成具體介面缺漏，電商營運可先決定修復產品可讀性、結帳或售後狀態的哪一段。
items.why_en: A diagnostic breakdown helps commerce teams prioritize product readability, checkout or order-status gaps before agent-commerce work.
items.next_step: 先用網店網址取得分數，按發現、結帳及售後把缺漏交予負責人，修復後重跑同一檢查；另行驗證實際購物流程。
items.next_step_en: Score a store URL, assign discovery, checkout and post-purchase gaps, then rerun after fixes and separately validate an actual shopping journey.
items.detail: UCP與ACP是讓購物代理與店面互通的協定。這次檢查器本身以固定規則計算分數，不能把產品名稱中的AI寫成自主代理實測。公司稱毋須安裝或提供系統存取權；完整報告會要求姓名、公司及工作電郵。編輯建議把分數當作排查清單，分開記錄修復項目及真正交易驗收，避免把滿分誤當成官方認證或所有代理均能購買。
items.detail_en: UCP and ACP are protocols connecting shopping agents with stores. The checker itself applies fixed rules, so it is not an autonomous-agent trial. The issuer says no installation or system access is required; full reports request name, company and work email. Treat scores as diagnostics, not certification or proof that every agent can buy.

evidence.audit_status: Ten complete same-assistant approvals. Original texts read and separately reopened; explicit AI/technology relevance, substitution test and wording reviews completed. Five timely Nov23–24 stories plus five unreported Nov18–19 developments within seven days, preserving original dates. No independent human review or product trials. Planned Pinterest scope, loveholidays production remit, eligible healthcare access, panel geography, model uncertainty and human write approvals retained.

review_provenance.second_pass: Same assistant separately re-retrieved source text to challenge dates, release stages, scope, attribution and unsupported outcomes; individual references retained.
